name: tailwind
description: Principles-driven Bootstrap-to-Tailwind migration for Rails views: scopes the work, audits the existing cascade per element, plans the translation, implements it behind approval gates, and verifies the result adversarially and visually with Playwright.

conventionsPath.title: Codebase conventions file
conventionsPath.description: File recording where views, layout partials, components, helpers, and Tailwind configs live in this repository, plus the module casing the autoloader requires. When unset, /migrate-to-tailwind searches the repository, then asks and offers to scaffold one from the plugin template. Highest-stakes setting here: wrong module casing fails at boot, and editing a Tailwind config the view does not load produces no visible change.

teamStandardsRoot.title: Team standards docs root
teamStandardsRoot.description: Root of your team's authoritative coding-standards documentation. It outranks this plugin's own standards layer whenever the two disagree. When unset, the command looks for standards in the repository, then asks once; if there are none, the plugin layer becomes authoritative and that is stated in the report.

notesRoot.title: Migration notes directory
notesRoot.description: Where resume documents and saved migration plans are written when you stop mid-migration. When unset, the command asks before writing and defaults to .claude/migration-notes/ inside the repository.
